name: brain
description: Amnesia Labs internal alpha. Invite only.
changelog: v0.10.2 — the SessionStart update check now says when the server cannot answer it. A 404 from /api/v1/api/plugin/latest/version used to be indistinguishable from "you are up to date": the hook failed quiet, so no install ever learned an update existed while brain.amnesia-labs.com ran a build predating the endpoint (brain#231). The hook now tells the two 404s apart — a missing route (stale server) and an empty plugin store — and reports each in one line. Every other failure stays silent. Prior: v0.10.1 folded in the 0.9.3–0.9.7 store lineage.
